info.name: Cvent REST APIs — Event Cloud Event Credits API

params.name: after
params.description: Used to query records that have been added or updated after this time point. Default to the beginning of time of the data store.

params.name: before
params.description: Used to query records that have been added or updated before this time point.

params.name: limit
params.description: The maximum number of records to return per page.

params.name: token
params.description:
The continuation token returned from a previous class. This must be a valid UUID v4 if provided.
This will override any other pageable parameters provided.

params.name: sort
params.description:
The `sort` query parameter sorts items in the list of results and organizes them according to your preference.
There are two orders:
  * ascending: ASC
  * descending: DESC

The following fields are sortable:
  * lastModified

params.name: expand
params.description:
Use the `expand` query parameter to include additional related information in the response. For each specified value, the related entity is retrieved and displayed inline.

An expandable object typically contains the ID of a related object in its response properties.

The following fields are expandable:
  * creditType(Includes only the `creditType.name` in the response. A full list of properties for `creditType` is not currently provided).

params.name: filter
params.description:
A filter query string narrows search
results and supports the combination of logical and comparison
operators.

The filter adheres to the pattern filter='field' comparisonType 'value'.

These are the comparison types that can be used in filter expressions:
  * equal: eq
  * not equal: ne

The following fields are filterable:
* attendee.id (eq|ne)
* event.id (eq|ne)
* session.id (eq|ne)
* creditType.id (eq|ne)
* type (eq)

Note:
* lastModified: Used by the 'before' and 'after' filters.

items.docs: Gets a paginated list of attendee event credits in your account.
